item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Taking it on schedule is a small, repeatable habit, and the habit does most of the work. Pick a fixed anchor you already do every day, and tie the dose to it, so you're not relying on memory or mood. If doses get missed, note why, without judgment, and look for the pattern. If you have questions about dosing or side effects, take them to your prescriber. Your action: set one daily reminder for your dose, right now.
